at_seal_time.detail: NFL-1 is 'NOT AUTHORIZED' and G0A is '11/12'. A forecast may be COMPUTED and SEALED locally, but it may not be published. No test result, checklist state or caller flag can change this -- only an owner authorization record.
at_seal_time.label: SHADOW / NOT AUTHORIZED
at_seal_time.note: This forecast is not published, not prospective evidence and not production output. It was executed internally under a frozen candidate configuration.

authorization_state.derived_from: nfl.production.authorization.may_publish(), the canonical gate. No flag was set by hand.

if_g0a_clears_before_kickoff: This artifact stays SHADOW. Authorization is a property of the moment a forecast is written, not a label applied afterwards: relabelling this run once the gate opens would make an unauthorized forecast look like an authorized one, which is the exact mislabelling the directive forbids. If G0A clears before kickoff a NEW forecast is written under the open gate and marked as the first live NFL-1 forecast.
label: SHADOW / NOT AUTHORIZED
postgame: Score this exact directory with nfl/tools/score_game.py once the final play-by-play exists. The seal is verified against SEAL_SHA256.txt before any outcome byte is read, and the scorer resolves those paths INSIDE this directory.
